data.name: Alitha
data.gender_notes: Alitha is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'aletheia', meaning truth, Alitha signifies nobility, honor, and truthfulness. This name was given to girls in ancient Greece who embodied these virtues. In Christianity, it is also a name for those who seek truth in their faith. The name Alitha carries the meaning “Noble, honorable, or truthful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alitha usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, honorable, or truthful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing the truth and honesty of God.
data.etymology: Alitha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, honorable, or truthful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alitha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_greek.name: Αλήθεια
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλήθεια προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για την αλήθεια ή την ειλικρίνεια. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την έννοια της αλήθειας και της ειλικρίνειας, και συχνά συσχετίζεται με την αρετή της ειλικρίνειας.

in_latin.name: Alitha
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Alitha is derived from the Latin word for truth or sincerity. In Christian tradition, the name Alitha carries the meaning of being truthful or sincere, reflecting the importance of honesty and integrity in one's faith and daily life.

The name Alitha conveys spiritual significance, reflecting a person's character and moral principles.
